en: Captain
Don't try to stop me, Roxie! Pokéstar Studios is calling, and this old sea dog is answering!
A captain who stars in films! Now that's a dream worth chasing!
Roxie
Are you kidding me?! You're already a captain! If that ship of yours doesn't sail, half the town's stuck on the quay!
Captain
Now, now, my girl. You run a Gym and sing in a band, don't you? If you can do two things, so can your old dad!
Roxie
ARGH! You stubborn, stuck-up, thick-headed old... DUNCE!
Two jobs aren't the problem! Leaving everybody stranded is the problem!
Studio Hand
Through here is the dream factory, Pokéstar Studios! But they're holding auditions, so no visitors just now.
They're giving the captain of Virbank's ship a screen test, can you believe it? Come back another time!
Roxie
So you lot are Team Plasma, huh?
Grunt
That's right! Two years ago the king we served turned his back on us, and our plans for Unova fell apart.
But we're not done. This time we'll gather the Pokémon we need, and nobody will get in our way!
{rival}
Save it! You talk about freeing Pokémon, but all you ever do is steal them!
I'll never forgive Team Plasma. Not ever!
Grunt
Ugh. First a Lillipup chases us all round the ranch, and now this lot...
This is getting to be a real drag.
Grunt
Relax. We'll just take their Pokémon too. Go on then, kids. Whenever you're ready!
{rival}
Let's crush them, {player}! Them and whatever they're scheming!
Grunt
What, you think you can beat me?
Ha! In a minute your Pokémon will be working for Team Plasma!
No way... beaten by a bunch of kids? Forget this. Run for it!
{rival}
Tch! What a bunch of creeps!
Roxie
We'll split up! I'll search the docks. You two, check Route 20 in case they double back that way!
And thanks. If I'd lost, my Pokémon would be in their hands right now. Here, take this!
{rival}
That's a Hidden Machine, isn't it? Cut! A Pokémon that knows it can chop down thin trees in your way.
Come on, {player}! Let's find that grunt on Route 20 before they get away!
Smart kid. Don't mess with Team Plasma!
Grunt
Talk to the one in charge, kid. We're just here to look tough.
Roxie
{player}! Get over here and lend a hand!
Go on, show them what a Badge holder can do!
{rival}
Thieves... Every last one of them.
Roxie
So? I saw your film. It wasn't bad, you know.
Captain
You saw it... Then you know. It wasn't the film, my girl. It was me.
I was so excited I forgot to become the hero. I was just a captain in a costume.
Roxie
Oh, come on, don't mope! You can keep auditioning and still sail your ship.
As long as you don't leave people stranded, I won't yell at you. Much.
Oh, {player}! Did you hear all that? Looks like every one of those Plasma creeps got away.
I hate letting them go, but at least they're out of Virbank. And Dad's back where he belongs!
Captain
Right you are! I'll thrill my passengers by charging through the roughest waves on the sea!
Anyone bound for Castelia City, come and find me in the terminal!
Roxie
Thanks for everything, {player}. Come by the club whenever you like!
Captain
Make way, make way! A star is on his way to the studios!
Ahoy! My ship's in the terminal's berth, waiting for passengers!
Roxie
That stubborn old man!
Dad's back at the helm. Now I can get back to my band!
